_comment: This file is source-repo metadata for the tier-3 fleet freshness report (scripts/check-consumer-freshness.sh). It also deploys into every consumer's .claude/context/reference/ directory because manifest.json's provides.context declares 'reference' as a whole directory -- that deployed copy is informational only and is never authoritative for any consumer's own behavior. Edit this file only in the source store (agent-system/extensions/core/context/reference/); a deployed copy is regenerated, not hand-maintained. See context/patterns/regeneration-is-manual-only.md's 'Detecting When You're Stale' section (Tier 3) for the full design.
